title: Potentiometer track burns out when it dissipates too much

implements.text: The potentiometer latches burnt when track power exceeds pmax (default 0.05 W) for 2 s

mocked.text: Once the rule fires the part stays burnt until it is repaired; the real part may survive or fail more slowly

unsupported.text: Thermal history; only the threshold and its dwell are checked

validation.dataset: figures/engine/bench-solve.test.mjs: a potentiometer divides 5 V and A0 reads the wiper

knownFailureCases: The 2 s window and the 0.05 W default have no source
